Kalman filtering for pairs trading — interactive demo

Pick a pair with the buttons. Drag-select on any panel to zoom; double-click to reset. Hover for values. Click items in the legend to hide/show series. The y₁ price uses the left axis on the top panel; y₂ uses the right axis.

What you are looking at: three estimators of the time-varying hedge ratio γₜ in y₁ ≈ μₜ + γₜ · y₂. Rolling LS (2y) recomputes ordinary least squares on a sliding two-year window. Kalman basic treats (μₜ, γₜ) as a hidden state with random-walk dynamics (model 15.3 in the textbook). Kalman + momentum adds γ̇ₜ so γₜ evolves as a local linear trend (model 15.4). The spread zₜ is the normalized residual; cumulative P&L is the integral of position × spread change for a threshold-z strategy.
